records.question: Compare Tikrikilla and Selsella blocks on Focus Plus: number of distinct beneficiaries, total amount disbursed, and amount disbursed per beneficiary.
records.sql: SELECT UPPER(block_name_raw) AS lgd_block, lgd_district, COUNT(DISTINCT beneficiary_key) AS distinct_beneficiaries, SUM(amount_disbursed) AS total_amount_disbursed, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT beneficiary_key) > 0 THEN SUM(amount_disbursed) / COUNT(DISTINCT beneficiary_key) ELSE 0 END AS amount_per_beneficiary FROM curated.v_focus_plus WHERE UPPER(block_name_raw) IN ('TIKRIKILLA', 'SELSELLA') AND NOT lgd_district IS NULL GROUP BY UPPER(block_name_raw), lgd_district ORDER BY UPPER(block_name_raw) LIMIT 10
records.answer:

TIKRIKILLA is higher than SELSELLA on distinct beneficiaries: 8,744 against 7,691, a difference of 1,053 (13.7% more).
